engine: PGlite embedded PostgreSQL, role/ACL SQL; native concurrency is a separate check

results.name: register atomically binds exact context and preserves OTP/TTL/attempts
missing accepted timestamp is set once and exact replay does not duplicate
anonymous and authenticated cannot execute RPCs or read receipt table
wrong cédula/celular/link cannot register or read another OTP
inactive or revoked link and inactive origin are rejected
plaintext unbound and expired/verified/consumed/failed OTPs cannot create a binding
provider ID and accepted timestamp are immutable even through direct backend update
one wamid cannot bind a second OTP
signed failure is separate from API acceptance and code/TTL/quotas stay intact
failed delivery blocks stale verifier update without changing other OTP fields
normal bound and plaintext verification is unaffected by the new trigger
wrong wamid/OTP and stale or future event timestamps are rejected
same signed event is idempotent and failure cannot be overwritten by late progress
out of order progress cannot regress state
read followed by older signed failure is terminal and preserves accepted history/TTL
whole second Meta timestamps before API acceptance are accepted only after OTP creation
expired old attempt event never changes a newer OTP or its guard
register replay stays bound to its original OTP even after a newer attempt exists
opaque attempt ID pins reads to the original OTP despite a newer same-context attempt
legacy read is bound, finite and excludes OTPs older than24h
existing functions ACLs guard and quota implementation are byte-for-byte preserved
